item.title: Version 0.8.9
item.description:
What's New

  • Update channel in Settings › General and Settings › About: stay on Stable, or choose Beta to get test builds first
  • macOS 26 and later: System Settings › Wallpaper shows one "Loomscreen — Selected Wallpaper" tile that follows the wallpaper each display runs in Loomscreen — thanks @Aleem2Z (#149)
  • Pro: on macOS 26 and later, that tile can play Wallpaper Engine scenes live — thanks @Aleem2Z (#149)
  • New option in Performance & Battery: pause only the display that has an app window on it — thanks @Aleem2Z (#147)

Improvements

  • The video frame kept as the macOS wallpaper refreshes every minute while the Mac is unlocked, so the lock screen shows a recent frame — thanks @Aleem2Z (#148)
  • Changing the volume or muting no longer re-captures the display's thumbnail

Bug Fixes

  • The menu bar volume reads 0% for a muted wallpaper, and for web pages from untrusted sites, which always play muted
  • Removing a display's wallpaper clears its thumbnail at the top of the display page at once

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明

item.title: Version 0.9.0b3
item.description:
Improvements

  • Remove unused code and consolidate duplicate implementations across the app and rendering modules.
  • Make required regression tests independent of a developer's Workshop library and optional system font downloads; keep real Workshop and rendering-oracle acceptance separate.
  • RC1: extended Release runtime, sleep/wake, physical multi-display and real capture-hiding acceptance remain pending.

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: improve SteamCMD first-launch setup and diagnostics.

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
